name: Samsung CRG9 49 Inch Dual QHD Curved Odyssey Gaming Monitor
description: Samsung CRG9 (C49RG9X / LC49RG90SSNXZA) 49-inch super ultrawide 32:9 curved QLED gaming monitor. Features an immersive 1800R curvature and a massive Dual QHD (5120 x 1440) resolution—equivalent to two 27-inch QHD monitors side by side. Equipped with a 120Hz refresh rate, HDR1000 peak brightness, and AMD FreeSync Premium Pro for ultra-smooth, tear-free gameplay. Includes Picture-by-Picture (PBP) multi-source multitasking and a height/tilt/swivel adjustable stand. Great condition, perfect for immersive gaming, video editing, or massive WFH productivity. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale!
name_zh: 三星 Samsung CRG9 49英寸32:9带鱼屏曲面电竞显示器
description_zh: 三星 Samsung CRG90系列（型号：C49RG9X / LC49RG90SSNXZA）49英寸 32:9 超宽曲面 QLED 游戏/办公显示器。拥有 5120x1440 双千兆（Dual QHD）分辨率，等同于两台 27 英寸 2K 显示器无缝并排拼接。具备 120Hz 刷新率、HDR1000 峰值亮度、QLED 量子点色彩技术以及 AMD FreeSync Premium Pro 专业防撕裂支持。支持 PBP 双画面多源同时输入、多任务分屏分栏，配有原厂可升降旋转调节的重型支架。成色极佳，无论是极客游戏、剪辑调色还是码农多窗办公都是顶配神器。毕业搬家低价痛快甩卖！
